goal: Isolate the node, wallet, and GUI into separate processes so crashes or exploits do not compromise the node
Allow components to run on independent lifecycles for improved stability and security
agreement: Strong long-standing concept consensus across multiple maintainers
Concept approval emphasizing the value of process isolation (laanwj)
Historical concept approval (dcousens, promag, jamesob, hebasto)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it delivers the executables needed to run the node, wallet, and GUI in separate processes
It provides the core milestone for the multi-year process separation effort
It unblocks downstream pull requests for isolated process execution

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it adapts wallet interfaces to support safe fault isolation in an independent process
It prevents wallet crashes from taking down the base node
It unblocks dedicated wallet process integration

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it prevents callback state from being retained indefinitely after disconnect
It eliminates test hangs and delays when shutting down processes
